captureNotes: The site is WordPress 6.8.8 + the WPPizza 3.17.4 plugin (theme: Astra, page builder: Elementor). The menu is rendered SERVER-SIDE into the category pages; there is no JavaScript menu SPA and no JSON menu API (wp-json exposes no wppizza namespace, and the wppizza post type is not REST-enabled). "Delivery Way" is the footer branding of the hosting provider, not a client-side renderer.
Every category was captured by a single rate-limited static GET of its own page, cross-checked against the site's WPPizza taxonomy archives and its wp-sitemap-posts-wppizza-1.xml.

Hähnchenbrust, Rumpsteak and Dessert have ZERO published items: their nav pages render an empty entry-content, their WPPizza taxonomy archives return no posts, a site search for each term returns no results, and none of the three terms appears in the taxonomy sitemap. They are empty on the server, not withheld from a static fetch.

German is authoritative. The site publishes NO English text for any item, category or allergen label, so nameEn/descriptionEn/labelEn are null throughout except allergen labelEn, which is taken from the site's own CSS semantic token (wppizza-allergen-<token>) and never translated by the capture.

sortOrder is the position within the category AS THE SITE RENDERS IT, which is NOT numeric order: WPPizza emits Pizza as 6,5,4,3,2,1,7,8,... and Mexikanisch as 101,102,108,107,106,111,... The capture preserves what a diner sees; re-sorting by item number is a presentation choice for the consuming app, not a correction to the source.
Prices are transcribed exactly as rendered (German decimal comma) and converted to integer cents. No rounding, no inference; the word 'ab' appears only inside descriptions, never in a price.

2026-09-14: category `antipasti-misto` and its two items (für 1 Person / für 2 Personen Vorspeisenteller) were REMOVED on the operator's instruction. The capture had found it as a published WPPizza taxonomy archive with no entry in the site navigation; the operator compared the site's navigation and full menu category by category (Home, Pizza, Vorspeisen, Nudeln, Frisch aus dem Ofen, Mexikanisch, Salate, Vegetarische Aufläufe, Fisch, Schweinefilet, Schnitzel, Hähnchenbrust, Rumpsteak, Getränke, Dessert, Angebote) and ruled that the menu does not carry it. Every other item, allergen code, description and price in this file was checked against that paste and matched.

availability.evidence: No item on any page carries a sold-out / unavailable marker; the plugin renders only a shop-level opening-hours widget (Mo., Mi.-Fr. 12:00-22:00 / Di. geschlossen / Sa., So. 13:00-22:00) and a global closed message 'Wir haben aktuell geschlossen'.
availability.note: Every item is emitted with available=true because the source states nothing per item. This is an absence of a source, not an observation that everything is in stock.

pickup.evidence: Each item renders exactly one price set; no page carries a second, pickup-specific price. The WPPizza runtime config advertises compat.puDel=1 (its pickup/delivery compatibility flag), and pickup vs delivery is chosen in the AJAX cart, but no per-item pickup price is published anywhere in the menu markup.
pickup.pickupOnlyOfferNote: Both Mittwochs-Angebote are marked '(für Selbstabholer)' in their own description — pickup-only products, not a pickup price for a delivered item.
